name: Arizona Header
description: The university's header bar: the wordmark logo on Blue, with header buttons (such as Search and Menu) that open an off-canvas panel on small screens. Its colors are brand colors: a Blue fill, and a White logo, labels, icons and focus ring. The original red header points the fill at Red.
sources: az-digital/arizona-bootstrap#2299: the blue header is the default
Motion: Bootstrap's default transitions, not yet reviewed by design

height.$description: Header height: its minimum height at every screen size, and its fixed height below 992px.

fixed-on-mobile.scroll-gap.$description: When the header is fixed on mobile (below 992px): the space between the bottom of the header and a linked section scrolled to it. Sections stop the header's height plus this gap below the top of the screen, so the header doesn't cover them.

logo.description: The wordmark, which links to the home page.

width.$description: Wordmark width below the sm breakpoint (576px).

height.$description: Wordmark height below the sm breakpoint (576px).

margin-left.$description: Space before the wordmark, at the header's left edge.

width.$description: Wordmark width from the sm breakpoint (576px) up.

height.$description: Wordmark height from the sm breakpoint (576px) up.

border.radius.$description: Corner radius of the logo and header buttons while they have keyboard focus, so the ring has rounded corners.

button.description: A header button, such as Search or Menu: an icon above a label.

min-height.$description: Header button minimum height: as tall as the header.

padding.y.$description: Header button top and bottom padding.

gap.$description: Space between a header button's icon and its label.

transition.duration.$description: How long a header button's colors and focus ring take to change. Not yet reviewed by design. Turned off when someone asks for reduced motion.

transition.easing.$description: Easing for a header button's color and focus ring changes. Not yet reviewed by design. Turned off when someone asks for reduced motion.

border.radius.$description: Corner radius of the logo and header buttons while they have keyboard focus, so the ring has rounded corners.

icon.description: The button's icon, the same color as its label.

size.$description: Header button icon width and height: the icon is 24px square, whether it's an SVG, a sprite or a font glyph.

label.description: The button's label, such as "Search" or "Menu".

offcanvas.description: The panel the header buttons open on small screens.

transition.duration.$description: How long the off-canvas panel (opened by the header buttons) takes to slide in or out. Not yet reviewed by design. Turned off when someone asks for reduced motion.

transition.easing.$description: Easing for the off-canvas panel's slide. Not yet reviewed by design. Turned off when someone asks for reduced motion.

backdrop.description: The backdrop behind the open panel.

transition.duration.$description: How long the backdrop behind the off-canvas panel takes to fade in or out. Not yet reviewed by design. Turned off when someone asks for reduced motion.

transition.easing.$description: Easing for the off-canvas backdrop's fade. Not yet reviewed by design. Turned off when someone asks for reduced motion.
